description: This file contains Orleans grain class implementations and related classes, defining behavior for grains in a distributed system, including methods for starting interactions, performing concurrent tasks, and managing grain state.

classes.name: FirstGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IFirstGrain, initiating parallel calls to SecondGrain instances.

classes.name: SecondGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing ISecondGrain, executing concurrent calls to ThirdGrain instances with different keys.

classes.name: ThirdGrainState
classes.description: A serializer class for maintaining state of ThirdGrain instances.

classes.name: ThirdGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IThirdGrain, managing a simple in-flight counter to prevent concurrent method calls.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates two asynchronous calls to SecondGrain with different GUIDs and waits for both to complete.

methods.name: SecondGrainMethod
methods.description: Performs concurrent calls to ThirdGrain instances for a set of keys, passing a GUID to each.

methods.name: ThirdGrainMethod
methods.description: Increments an in-flight counter, throws if more than one call is in progress, writes state asynchronously, then decrements the counter.
